channel.title: Balvan Agro Seeds — Latest News & Seed Releases
channel.description: Latest research releases, field trial results, and agricultural seed updates from Balvan Agro Seeds in Gujarat, India.

item.title: BALVAN-GORI Fodder Bajra Launched for Kharif Season
item.description: Balvan Agro introduces BALVAN-GORI, a high-yielding fodder bajra variety delivering 400+ quintals per acre with 4-5 cuttings.

item.title: BALVAN-GORI Multi-Location Trial Results Released
item.description: Multi-location field trials across Gujarat, Rajasthan and Haryana demonstrate 35% higher green biomass yield in BALVAN-GORI compared to conventional check varieties.

item.title: Farmer Ramesh Patel Records 400 Quintal Fodder Yield with BALVAN-GORI
item.description: Progressive dairy farmer from Banaskantha district reports record multi-cut fodder harvest, lowering feed costs by 28%.

item.title: Balvan Agro Expands Tharad Seed Processing Facility
item.description: State-of-the-art seed conditioning, gravity grading and automated packaging facility commissioned in Tharad, Gujarat.

item.title: Industry Dialogue on Climate-Resilient Fodder Seed Systems
item.description: Agricultural scientists, seed breeders and dairy leaders convene to discuss drought-tolerant fodder solutions for Western India.

item.title: Balvan Agro Kisan Mela 2025 Attracts Over 3,500 Farmers
item.description: Annual farmer fair showcases field demonstration plots, soil health workshops and variety selection guides in Tharad.
